title: gaitTherapyBiomarkers: supplementary analysis code and derived gait data
description:
Prepublication research supplementary materials for the manuscript Interpretable Machine Learning Evaluates Differential Therapy Effects in Parkinsonian Gait. The archive includes original Python analysis scripts, pseudonymized derived gait and clinical feature tables, aggregate cohort statistics, documentation, and machine-readable analysis results. It does not include raw motion-capture trajectories or linked source clinical records.

This is a software/data supplementary archive, not a published or accepted journal/conference paper. A manuscript DOI will be linked only when available.
